summary: MDM rollout changed SAML device attribute (device.serialNumber) -> RBAC claim dropped; blocks bastion, Grafana and CI access for macOS users
description:
Issue summary: After a staged MDM update rolled to macOS endpoints, affected users report successful SSO but immediate 403/permission denied when trying to access internal bastion, Grafana dashboards and CI (Buildkite) webhooks. Impact: ~18 engineers across eng/platform reported inability to access infra tools during weekday morning. Root cause suspected to be SAML attribute/claim mismatch after MDM introduced a new device attribute naming scheme in Okta app profile mappings.

Impact: Blocked on-call actions and pipeline restarts; engineers needed manual SSH bastion tickets and manual CI reruns.

Environment: prod (us-west) - all affected users were in prod SSO flows using Okta + Device Trust via Intune/MDM.

Observed behavior: SSO redirect completes, users reach auth callback, then our auth-proxy drops the device_trust claim and RBAC mapping returns no roles -> 403 from downstream services.

Expected behavior: Device-trust assertion to include device.id or equivalent claim so RBAC determines proper console roles and grants access to bastion/Grafana/CI tokens.

Initial detection: Alerts from Grafana access logs and a Slack surge in #oncall triggered this ticket.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Enroll a macOS device on latest MDM rollout (staged channel)
2) Sign in to Redwood Console via Okta SSO with device-trust flow enabled
3) Complete SAML redirect to auth-proxy and observe callback logs
4) Attempt to access ssh-gateway (bastion) or Grafana dashboard; observe 403 and missing roles in token claims
logs: auth-proxy (prod) trace: Received SAML assertion from Okta for user = ava.martinez@redwood.com
Claim transformer output: device_trust claim = null (was expecting device.id or device.uuid)
Grafana proxy: authorization denied - no roles found for subject ava.martinez@redwood.com
investigation_notes: 03/13 09:12 - Reporter (Ava) posted in #oncall: SSO succeeded but can't open bastion; many similar reports.
03/13 09:22 - Support rotated to SRE to gather SAML assertion dumps; confirmed the incoming assertion contains device.serialNumber instead of device.id.
03/13 10:05 - Checked Okta app profile mappings: a recent MDM vendor change pushed a mapping template that renamed device.id -> device.serialNumber for enrolled macOS devices (staged rollout).

03/13 10:33 - Auth-proxy's claim transformer only accepts 'device.id' and 'device.uuid' and treats other device.* attributes as non-device; therefore device_trust was not set and RBAC returned no roles.
03/13 11:00 - Verified only macOS devices on staged MDM channel affected; Windows and Linux device-assertions unchanged.
03/13 11:30 - Correlated affected user list with MDM rollout cohort; 18 unique users impacted in prod-us-west.
03/13 12:10 - Temporary mitigation: updated RBAC override to grant 'oncall-readonly' to affected users to allow emergency access; added manual exceptions for CI tokens where needed.
comments: Ava Martinez (reporter) - 2026-03-13 09:15: 'Signed in, SSO shows successful, then Grafana returns 403. Can't SSH to bastion either.'
SRE Triage (Devon Chen) - 2026-03-13 09:45: 'Collecting SAML trace dumps and verifying attribute names. Please preserve samples and do not repro with admin accounts.'

IAM (Priya Rao) - 2026-03-13 10:10: 'Okta confirmed a mapping tweak deployed to the macOS MDM app profile as part of vendor 5.2.1 rollout; they reverted the change for non-production but prod rollout already started.'
Dev (Leo Fischer) - 2026-03-13 11:40: 'Auth-proxy patch prepared to accept device.serialNumber as fallback. Created PR and posted to #infra-deploy.'

SRE (Devon Chen) - 2026-03-13 13:05: 'Rolled auth-proxy patch to prod (hotfix): claim transformer now reads device.id | device.uuid | device.serialNumber. Recovery verified for 18 affected users. Will open follow-up to add integration test.'
resolution: Short-term fix: deployed auth-proxy hotfix to accept 'device.serialNumber' as a valid device identifier fallback; restored device_trust claim mapping and RBAC resolution for affected users. Reverted the Okta MDM mapping in coordination with MDM vendor to prevent further attribute renames. Long-term actions: (1) Add resilient claim mapping that supports canonicalization and attribute aliasing, (2) Add integration test in CI to detect claim name drift during SSO flows, (3) Update SSO runbook with explicit MDM-to-Okta attribute contract and rollback playbook. Postmortem scheduled and owner assigned (Priya Rao).
follow_up_tasks: Create integration test to assert device claim presence across enrollment cohorts (owner: Devon) - target 2026-03-21
Formalize attribute contract with MDM vendor and block unapproved mapping changes (owner: Priya Rao) - target 2026-03-28
Add alert rule to detect sudden drop in device_trust claims per region (owner: Monitoring) - target 2026-03-18
